labels.quote: Alphabet's revenues increased 8.7% from $282.8 billion in 2022 to $307.4 billion in 2023.
Operating margin expanded to 27.4% in 2023, with operating income of $84.3 billion on revenues of $307.4 billion.
Net income grew 18.9% from $60.0 billion in 2022 to $73.8 billion in 2023.
Net income was $73.8 billion in 2023 (Source: Alphabet 10-K 2022).
